facts.fact: 天亮时 Harrison 把车冲进医院门口停下并跑进医院，分诊护士安抚他后，两名护士推着担架冲向汽车。
facts.anchor: Day broke as Harrison threw his car into park and sprinted through the hospital entrance.

facts.fact: Gazzie 瘫在后座、手垂在身侧，医护人员把她抬上担架推进医院，一名护士直着双臂给她做胸外按压。
facts.anchor: Together they placed her on the gurney and rolled her inside, one nurse pumping at her chest with stiff arms.

facts.fact: 抢救没有成功，叙述者确认自己的祖母已经死了。
facts.anchor: They couldn’t bring her back to life, of course; my grandmother was dead.

facts.fact: 一名头发葡萄色的护士把“我”单独带进房间，问祖母的伤是怎么来的。
facts.anchor: “How did she sustain her injury?” she asked.

facts.fact: “我”用单调的语气谎称风刮破防风板、树枝砸碎窗户、祖母摔倒撞进玻璃，且称自己当时不在房间。
facts.anchor: “Wind broke a storm shutter,” I said in a monotone. “Branch busted through a window.

facts.fact: 护士盯着“我”的手寻找伤害或挣扎的痕迹，“我”悄悄把手翻过来，露出没有破损的指节。
facts.anchor: The nurse eyed my hands, looking for signs that I’d hurt Gazzie, that she’d struggled.

facts.fact: 面对肿胀得快塞不进网球鞋的脚，“我”告诉护士那是鳄鱼咬的。
facts.anchor: which barely fit in my tennis shoe at that point, a wave of dizziness hit me. “Alligator bite.”

facts.fact: “我”下意识要求大量补液并说明自己有 POTS，随后在护士的操作中陷入黑暗、失去意识。
facts.anchor: “And I need lots of fluids,” I added automatically, eyes fluttering closed. “I’ve got POTS.”

facts.fact: “我”在医院病床上醒来，对祖母之死仍无内疚，只是模糊地担心 Aunt Virginia 或 Harrison 会不会向警方告发自己。
facts.anchor: I still felt no angst about my grandmother’s death, only vaguely wondering whether Aunt Virginia or Harrison

facts.fact: 另一名护士告知“我”：咬伤已过去两夜，脚打了石膏并用了抗生素，还让“我”服用 fludrocortisone 升血压。
facts.anchor: a different nurse marched in, explaining that two nights had passed since the bite had broken my foot

facts.fact: 护士向“我”转述 Gazzie 是到院即亡，官方说法是她绊倒撞进碎窗、背部有动脉，可能没受多少痛苦。
facts.anchor: “I’m so sorry, dear. She passed on arrival. Apparently, she tripped and fell into a broken window?

facts.fact: “我”明白是 Aunt Virginia 和 Harrison 替自己撒了谎，不会再有调查，这会让“我”更容易消失。
facts.anchor: So Aunt Virginia and Harrison had lied for me. There would be no investigation.

facts.fact: Harrison 在走廊与护士争执，说自己送祖母进来时人就在场，并坚持要等上级来处理。
facts.anchor: “I was with her when she came in,” he argued.

facts.fact: “我”挣扎坐起，认为自己无法承受 Harrison 得知真相后的厌恶目光和得知自己毫不后悔时的恐惧。
facts.anchor: I wouldn’t be able to bear Harrison’s look of disgust at what I’d done, his horror when I explained I didn’t regret it.

facts.fact: “我”认定 Mama 说得对：没有人能在看到真实的“我”之后还爱“我”，而且 Harrison 已经看到了一切。
facts.anchor: No. Mama had been right. No one could love me after seeing the real me, and Harrison had seen everything.

facts.fact: “我”拔掉身上的监护线，避开护士台前的 Harrison，换上 T 恤和运动裤后拄拐从侧门离开医院。
facts.anchor: Then I limped down the hallway and out a side entrance, phone in hand.

facts.fact: Uber 司机对地址起疑，“我”确认这就是目的地 Greer House，推门下车、把拐杖拿出车外。
facts.anchor: “This is it,” I confirmed, clicking open the door and shoving my crutches out.

facts.fact: 院子里 Flora 的洪水冲出了几十年积存的鳄鱼骨，“我”想到 Ironheart 一定很高兴、甚至在庆祝。
facts.anchor: decades of alligator bones freed by Flora’s floodwaters. Ironheart must have been pleased. Celebrating, even.

facts.fact: “我”从窗户进入 Greer House，屋内已没有任何 Ida 的痕迹——没有寒意、没有茉莉香水味、没有嗡嗡声。
facts.anchor: Nothing remained of Ida—no chill, no jasmine perfume, no buzzing.

facts.fact: 楼上画板上还留着一页栗色模糊、一只黑眼睛瞪着“我”的画；“我”合上速写本，从衣柜取出旅行袋开始往里塞衣服准备离开。
facts.anchor: I shut the sketchbook, retrieved my duffel bag from the closet, and began to shove clothes inside
